AI Security Mailbox (formerly known as Abuse Mailbox)
Get a list of messages submitted to AI Security Mailbox (formerly known as Abuse Mailbox) that were not analyzed.

params.name: start
params.description: The start of the datetime range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, to fetch unanalyzed messages from. Defaults to 90 days before end.

params.name: end
params.description: The end of the datetime range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, to fetch unanalyzed messages from. Defaults to the current time.

items.docs: Get a list of messages submitted to AI Security Mailbox (formerly known as Abuse Mailbox) that were not analyzed.

info.name: Get a list of campaigns submitted to AI Security Mailbox (formerly known as Abuse Mailbox)

params.name: filter
params.description: Value must be of the format `filter={FILTER KEY} gte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ lte YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. A `{FILTER KEY}` must be specified, and currently the keys `lastReportedTime` and `receivedTime` are supported for `/abusecampaigns`. At least one of `gte`/`lte` must be specified, with a datetime string following the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` format. `lastReportedTime` defaults to the last 24h if unspecified. Do note that provided filter time is in UTC.

params.name: sender
params.description: Filters threats based on the name or email address of the sender

params.name: recipient
params.description: Filters threats based on the name or email address of the recipient

params.name: subject
params.description: Filters threats based on the email subject

params.name: reporter
params.description: Filters threats based on the reporter name or email address

params.name: attackType
params.description: Filters threats based on the type of attack

params.name: threatType
params.description: Filters threats based on the type of threat

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of abuse campaigns shown on each page. Each page of data will have at most pageSize abuse campaign IDs.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: 1-indexed page number to get a particular page of abuse campaigns. Has no effect if filter is not specified.
